description: This file implements classes and methods for handling NR PPA (Positioning Protocol for NR) protocol messages, including encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization. It defines structures for initiating messages, outcomes, and the overall PDU, with specific procedures identified by procedure codes.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the NR PPA Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with methods for setting, packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the initiating message structure with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and response content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and failure content.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Contains static methods and data for mapping procedure codes to message types and validation.

methods.name: get_init_msg
methods.description: Returns the appropriate init_msg_c object based on procedure code.

methods.name: get_successful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the successful_outcome_c object based on procedure code.

methods.name: get_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the unsuccessful_outcome_c object based on procedure code.
